{{Top|leg}}
'''''Floating Home''''' was Lord [[Ecclessis Figg/Legends|Ecclessis Figg's]] first [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] colony, built to collect [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]]. ''Floating Home'' later served as the template for the development of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[Bespin: Action Tidings]] says that Floating Home was renamed to Cloud City.
